verdict.rationale:
n8n's Code/Function nodes and JavaScript/Python support let users write custom expressions and code to map and transform data between workflow steps, corroborated by both marketing docs and hands-on community accounts describing writing SQL, extracting JSON/XML, and building custom transformation logic. Community also confirms debuggability by showing data in/out per node, reinforcing that transform steps are core to the product.

missing for 10: dedicated documentation excerpts on the expression editor syntax (e.g. n8n's {{ }} expression language) and Function node specifics, plus more independent hands-on validation beyond forum anecdotes.
